names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουνίου, «Αγία Ία (ή Ίγια) η διδασκάλισσα», with the rank word and the office left off. The page gives «Ίγια» as a variant and, in the narrative, the full «Ία Γουέν».

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγια Ια (ή Ιγια) η Διδασκαλισσα (; - 1900)», and the account places the killing in the persecution that began on the night after 10 June 1900. The page gives no year of birth.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026). saint.gr makes her a teacher in the Russian mission at Peking, so a Russian row is very likely to exist; it was not looked for and nothing is claimed about it.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Μητροφάνης Τσί-Σούνγκ και οι μαζί μ' αυτόν μαρτυρήσαντες: … Αγία Ία (ή Ίγια) η διδασκάλισσα …»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and dates her «(; - 1900)». She is not the corpus's `ia-of-persia`, the fourth-century martyr under Shapur. The entry enumerates its members, so she is a folder of her own. None of the page's hymns names her. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
